methods.description: Actual original-schema PostgreSQL/PGlite full prepared membership parity, no-new-writes rollback, strict compact public/private catalog pins, restricted runtime, raw export and independent logical restore; negative ACL/owner/foreign-key/view controls, durable interrupted export and typed import/snapshot tests. Synthetic registries; no live provider or native backup proof.
methods.units: bytes, rows, milliseconds, test count; metadata numeric fields are catalog enums
